About

Maftuna Mukhamova is a Dubai-based model, muse and UGC creator. Her work moves between the city's two faces — the heritage lanes and old-town courtyards of historic Dubai, and the glass skyline of Downtown and the Marina.

With an audience of 23.9K on Instagram, she creates polished editorial imagery and short-form video for fashion, beauty and lifestyle stories — always styled around one idea: elegance that never fades.
